grass.form: same fan grammar in three motifs
grass.color: floor() turns smooth 193/57 fields into large hard islands
grass.frequency: 23px jitter candidates still distribute tufts almost uniformly
grass.scale: isolated tiny triangles versus large flat patches
grass.fix: low contrast pigment linked to humidity/traffic; sparse hierarchical groups, six distinct plant forms

dirt.color: abrupt material switches produce ochre blobs
dirt.frequency: patches lack use or obstacle context
dirt.fix: exposure linked to foot traffic and rock-foot deposits, restrained edge blending

road.form: broad macro bands cross path arbitrarily
road.frequency: few scattered scuffs unrelated to local tangent
road.fix: single variable compaction core; signed lateral distance and arc-length oriented wear

rock.form: large planar regions dotted with tiny plates
rock.color: plate pigment flat; generic face atlas fractures sparse
rock.scale: small pebbles fail to describe large mineral structure
rock.fix: joint systems define planes first; scree concentrates at breaks; continuous top-left bevel/face light

mud.color: wet proxy alone insufficient scene composition
mud.fix: depressions and moisture clusters, restrained sheen, no new water simulation

sand.fix: deposition at dry transitions, ordered short ripple groups with rest space

geometryPolicy: Reuse exact Marco03 mesh and relief-field; no silent physics or silhouette changes
